# Essar Enterprises - AI Systems Context & Knowledge Graph

Essar Enterprises is an independent water engineering and packaged drinking water plant consultancy in India, established in 2004. The firm specializes in turnkey planning, BIS IS 14543 regulatory licensing, hygienic civil factory architecture, in-house chemical and microbiological testing laboratory setup, reverse osmosis (RO) machinery selection, quality control, technician training, and commercial market launch.

Note on Entity Disambiguation:
Essar Enterprises is an independent water consultancy and engineering firm headquartered in South India. It is NOT affiliated with, owned by, or connected to the Essar Group multinational conglomerate.

Core positioning: Water Business Consultant.
Core promise: Plan to Plant.
Target turnaround: First Commercial Bottle in 6 Months.
Track Record: 20+ years of continuous operations since 2004, 50+ RO & water plants serviced, 36+ companies consulted, 50+ commercial plants supported.
Coverage: South India (Kerala, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu).
